question: How must the four dolls be endowed with described characteristics and linked to the sādhya constellation tree?
premises: four dolls are to be made properly
they must be linked to sādhya constellation tree
inference: proper doll construction requires both constellation-tree linkage and described marks
uncertainties: exact identification of sādhya constellation remains uncertain
agreement of saṃyutāḥ with puttalīḥ is inferred from context
plain_english: The four dolls should also be made with the tree of the sādhya constellation and endowed with the described characteristics.
